posts.title: MAAV Competes at IARC 2024
posts.excerpt: Our team traveled to compete in the International Aerial Robotics Competition, showcasing months of hard work.
posts.content:
Our team traveled to compete in the International Aerial Robotics Competition, showcasing months of hard work in autonomous flight systems.

The competition challenged us to demonstrate autonomous navigation, object detection, and precise flight control. Our drone successfully completed multiple mission objectives.

Thank you to all team members who made this possible!
posts.author: MAAV Team

posts.title: New Drone Frame Design Complete
posts.excerpt: The structures team has finished designing our next-generation carbon fiber frame.
posts.content:
The structures team has finished designing our next-generation carbon fiber frame.

Key improvements include:
- Reduced weight by 15%
- Improved vibration dampening
- Better component accessibility
- Optimized for manufacturing

We used SolidWorks for CAD modeling and ran extensive FEA simulations to validate the design.
posts.author: Structures Team

posts.title: Fall Recruitment Now Open
posts.excerpt: Join MAAV this fall! We're looking for passionate students interested in autonomous systems.
posts.content:
Join MAAV this fall! We're looking for passionate students interested in autonomous systems.

No prior experience required - just enthusiasm and willingness to learn. We have positions open on all three subteams:

- Software: Computer vision, navigation, controls
- Structures: CAD, manufacturing, testing
- Embedded: PCB design, firmware, integration

Apply through our Google Form linked on the homepage!
